title: Hexagonal head (2 parts)
spec:
Create a cylindrical shaft by first setting up a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of [0.0256, 0.0256, 0.6818]. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a single face, creating a single loop and drawing a circle with its center at [0.0341, 0.0341] and a radius of 0.0341. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0682. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it using the vector [0.0256, 0.0256, 0.6818]. Extrude the sketch in the opposite direction of the normal by 0.6818 units to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical shaft are a length of 0.06818181818181819, a width of 0.06818181818181819, and a height of 0.6818181818181819.

For the hexagonal head, start by creating another new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of [0.0, 0.0, 0.6818]. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on a single face, creating a single loop and drawing a circle with its center at [0.0597, 0.0597] and a radius of 0.0597. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.1193. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it using the vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.6818]. Extrude the sketch towards the normal by 0.0682 units and join this extrusion to the existing body. The final dimensions of the hexagonal head are a length of 0.11931818181818182, a width of 0.11931818181818182, and a height of 0.06818181818181819.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the first part (Pen)
pen = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0341, 0.0341)
    .circle(0.0341)
    .extrude(-0.6818)  # Extrude downwards
    .translate((0.0256, 0.0256, 0.6818))  # Translate to the final position
)

# Create the second part (Cylinder)
cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0597, 0.0597)
    .circle(0.0597)
    .extrude(0.0682)  # Extrude upwards
    .translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.6818))  # Translate to the final position
)

# Combine the parts
r = pen.union(cylinder)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Shaft: cylinder along Z
shaft_d = 0.076
shaft_len = 0.68
head_d = 0.1194
head_h = 0.07

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(shaft_d / 2)
    .extrude(shaft_len)
    .faces(">Z")
    .workplane()
    .circle(head_d / 2)
    .extrude(head_h)
)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the profile and revolve it around the Z axis
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(0.035, 0)          # shaft radius
    .lineTo(0.035, 0.675)      # shaft length up to head
    .lineTo(0.0597, 0.675)     # head radius (0.1194 / 2)
    .lineTo(0.0597, 0.75)      # head height
    .lineTo(0, 0.75)
    .close()
    .revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1))
)
